# The Ghoul update is coming in March 2025

![The Ghoul Update is coming in March 2025](/uploads/442_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

In November 2024 I had the great opportunity to take part in an exclusive Fallout 76 event in London. Bethesda Germany invited me to fly to London with some other content creators. And it was great!

![](/uploads/nukaknights-london2024-2024-11-12-10.48.38.jpg)

I met many interesting YouTubers, content creators and gaming journalists and the Bethesda team was very open and helpful. The entire Bethesda office in London was redecorated as a vault, we saw exclusive trailers about the Ghoul Update (announced for March 2025), were able to play the alpha version of the Ghoul Update, had a ghoul visit and I was even able to do an unexpected interview with Jon Rush! If you haven't read it yet you can find the interview here: Fallout 76: Interview with Jonathan Rush in London 2024

![](/uploads/nukaknights-london2024-2024-11-12-10.19.01.jpg) All participants even received a goodie bag with the Ultrazit Terror hand puppet (which I have already used in a few videos), a Fallout shirt (which Jon Rush and Bill LaCoste personally signed for me), some Ghoul stickers, a Ghoul pin and Ultrazit candy cane.

I had a great time there and would do it again at any time!

![](/uploads/nukaknights-london2024-2024-11-13-11.18.16.jpg)

## The "more playable ghoul"

So far it has not been possible to slip into the role of a ghoul in either Fallout 76 or other Fallout parts. That will change in March 2025. With the upcoming update you can transform your character into a ghoul, with all the advantages and disadvantages.

At the event in London we were the first exclusive group to play the alpha version of the Ghoul update. From **December 20th, 2024**, the **PTS will also be online again**, where you can already play the new version on the PC. Nuka Knights is of course back on the PTS and will test the gameplay as well as look for interesting innovations under the hood via data mining.

### A quest turns you into a ghoul

You can make your existing character a ghoul. To do this you can go through a new ghoulification quest. This quest first takes you to the Whitespring Resort, where you meet Lehman. He was attacked by bandits and contracted severe radiation sickness. Now he is looking for a doctor or specialist who can help him.

### New locations in northeast Appalachia

The quest now takes you further up into the northeast of Appalachia. There are new locations and a new outpost there. You won't find a doctor or specialist at the outpost, but there is an elevator. This elevator takes you to a bunker that looks very familiar to us. It looks like a nuclear missile launch silo. And here you will also find a radiation specialist.

![Ghoul Quest Locations](/uploads/nukaknights-post-ghoul-locations-marker.jpg)

However, Lehman is so badly contaminated that there is only one way out. The only way to save him is to turn him into a ghoul. He agrees.

After this experience, our player isn't feeling particularly well either, and we also turn to the doc to get ourselves sorted out. He offers to heal us too...on the house. For this process, the specialist has an inhaler ready that turns us into a ghoul.

### The new ghoul appearance

From now on we are a ghoul and the first thing we can do is choose our appearance. Numerous hairstyles, features, scars and skin types are available. You can choose whether you want to be a male or female ghoul.
